Hi Marcus —

Thanks for scheduling. I don’t see a usable calendar invite in my Google Calendar — the .ics attached shows but when I click it the join link is a Meet URL (meet.google.com/xxx) and my org’s security blocks guest Meet links; we require Zoom with SSO-enabled join. Also the ICS import looks corrupted in our calendar system (it creates a duplicate phantom event that can’t be accepted).

Can you resend as a native Zoom invite (hosted by an external Zoom account) or provide a plain-text Zoom join link and dial-in numbers? Prefer to avoid importing an ICS that our system rejects.

Alex
Director, Platform Integrations
ZetaCorp

Hi Alex —

Sorry for the trouble — the calendar generator defaulted to a Google Meet event (we normally use Zoom for partner demos; not sure how Meet slipped in). I’m going to: 

- Recreate the event from Marcus’s Zoom account and send a new invite (native Zoom invite should avoid the Meet token).
- Include explicit dial-in numbers and SSO domain (so your admins can allowlist if needed).
- Attach a short note for your calendar admin in case the ICS import still misbehaves.

For transparency: the broken ICS you saw was because the event organizer field was set to a service account that your calendar treats as external; that can cause auto-reject/phantoms in some tenant setups. Re-sending from Marcus’s Zoom should help.

I’ll loop Rishi for calendar-level workarounds in case we need to create the event on your side.

Attachment: zetacorp-sso-guidance.pdf (short steps for calendar admins)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett

Thanks, that sounds good. Two small asks from our side: 

1) When you recreate the event can you set the organizer to someone@zetacorp.com (we can be added as a co-organizer) or send the invite as a direct calendar invite (not an attachment) — that avoids the ICS import path that triggers our rules.
2) Can you include US toll dial-in numbers and the meeting passcode in the invite body (we have a few team members who call in from low-bandwidth locations)?

If it’s easier, you can also send me a one-off calendar event from my email address and I’ll accept — that will show up cleanly for our users.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex
